features.quote: Loop ends on: model emits `submit`, max turns reached, or hard stop (e.g. context budget exceeded)
max_turns ≈ 14** — long enough to let the spiral develop and the tail to be "sustained", short enough to cap cost
Disengagement (D)** — gives up, stops calling tools, asks the user to do it, emits empty/degenerate actions, or refuses to continue
features.justification_quote: Per-axis signals, all computed per assistant turn over the trajectory
